activities.name: Sakhir winter camping season
activities.note: the Southern Governorate sets the season each year and registers campers in advance; it suspended the 2025-26 season early, in March 2026

windows.reason: the desert camping season in the south, run by the Southern Governorate
dates move each year: the 2024-25 season opened on 20 November, the 2025-26 season was set to run until 25 March

activities.name: Spring of Culture
activities.note: the festival paused in 2026 and its organisers plan to return in 2027

windows.reason: an annual arts festival each March since 2005, with internationally known musicians and artists

activities.name: Bahrain Grand Prix
activities.note: the 2026 race was moved to Malaysia after the outbreak of the Iran war; it is scheduled to return to Sakhir

windows.reason: the Formula One race at Sakhir, scheduled for mid-March as the season opener; its date has moved between March and April over the years
